title: AUTO PERFECT BLOCK, MOST O.P SCRIPT | PVP SCRIPT
features:
COMBAT
- Auto Perfect Block with a toggle key, block range, "only if they face me" and "nearest player only"
- Block Regular Punches, Beach Boy E and Y, projectiles priority, allow re-blocking, keep block while holding F
- Coliseum (1v1/2v2) mode and Unblocking
- Block timing bar
- Dodge incoming attacks
- Auto unstun with an unstun delay
- No bleed damage and no fire damage
- Barrage counter with dash out first, barrage back, key and length
- Auto re-summon stand
- Camera lock-on and face target
- Teammates list, ignore friends and ignore gang members
- Target dock showing the enemy's moves on cooldown
- Y Ability on a target
- Kidnap (Coco Jumbo E)
- Stand control
- God mode
- Dash power
- Sprint boost, auto sprint and Auto Agility V (Agility V sprint and dash without spending the skill points)
- Extra speed
- Moves can't be cancelled by other players' hits
- Macro recorder and player with saved macros, play key and speed
- Build Vault: save, load and delete builds
- Unknown attack logger

FARM
- Item Farm: pick the items, nearest first, auto hop to quiet servers with a wait before hopping
- Run again after hopping
- Auto sell with an item list and a sell-when-carrying amount, plus a Sell now button
- Auto convert candy with a candy-before-converting slider and a Turn in candy now button
- Quest Farm: pick the quest giver and it kills what they ask for
- Auto prestige
- Auto arcade
- Shop and code redeemer
- Auto buy Lucky Arrow with a money-to-keep amount

AUTOMATICS
- Auto Stand: pick the stands you want, grind until shiny, and Evolved Stand (C-Moon and others)
- Auto Luckys: max Lucky Arrows and 1x Lucky Arrow modes
- Auto prestige
- Kick at a Lucky Arrow limit or a money limit

WORLD
- Teleports: go to an NPC, a place or a player, plus click teleport and spectate player
- Character noclip and camera noclip
- Player ESP: glow through walls, bold name, level, health bar, stand, fighting style and distance
- Friend and gang member colors
- Item ESP and boss and NPC ESP
- Weather changer
- Render distance, 3D off and remove trees and bushes
- Name hider for recordings

STATUS AND SAFETY
- Anti AFK
- Staff alert and leave when staff joins
- Rare item alerts
- Server hop and rejoin buttons
- Discord webhook for alerts
- Bypasses
- Works in the main game, Steel Ball Run and 1v1 matches
